benchmark.policy: Fractional initial capital at first opening pre-slippage market mark; final execution close; no fee, leverage or FX. Exact reference entry/rounding policy unverified.

policies: Signals are available only at their declared completed bar. Default market execution is the next supplied bar open.
Nonstandard-chart strategies default to chart prices, including synthetic prices. Heikin-Ashi may explicitly use matching standard OHLC; display-scale price settings never change fills.
The assumed intrabar route is open-high-low-close when open is closer to high, otherwise open-low-high-close. Equal-distance ties choose low first as an LV policy pending reference comparison.
Gap-crossed orders execute at the next open when eligible. Limit verification requires penetration by configured ticks; a verified intrabar limit fills at its limit price.
Market and stop-market fills include configured adverse slippage. Limit and stop-limit fills do not add slippage.
FIFO lots allocate entry/exit virtual commissions to partial closed trades. Open profit includes remaining entry commissions.
Drawdown is reported separately for supplied bar closes and the assumed intrabar route. Neither proves actual tick-by-tick historical risk.
Full quantity fills ignore actual book liquidity, queue priority and partial liquidity fills. Borrow fees, currency conversion and automatic margin liquidation are not yet modeled.
Recalculation on every tick or fill, and Bar Magnifier, require additional event data and executable callbacks; unsupported requests are rejected.
All orders, capital, commissions and performance are simulated. No funding, billing or broker connection exists.
Execution stops with an error when the working-order evaluation budget is exhausted. Partial results are not a completed backtest.
All values are virtual. Bar timestamps identify source events, not exact intrabar execution times.
Fractional initial capital at first opening pre-slippage market mark; final execution close; no fee, leverage or FX. Exact reference entry/rounding policy unverified.
Trade counts represent FIFO closed allocations. Partial-close grouping and excursion commission conventions remain unverified against the reference.
Unavailable reference metrics are retained with reasons. The close-equity series is the full actual run, not a direction-only rerun.
Report display controls do not rerun the strategy. Exports contain the accepted result identity and all available columns.
